whatIsOpenDjed.description: Open DJED is a transparent, community-driven web app for interacting with the DJED algorithmic stablecoin on Cardano, built entirely open source by Artifi Labs. It recreates the original DJED experience with full protocol compatibility - offering a more reliable, accessible, and auditable alternative.

items.communityFirst: Protocol compatible: Same overcollateralized logic as DJED.
items.globalAccess: Open source: Fully auditable, forkable, and community-owned.

items.transparentFees: Transparent & low fees: Same COTI fee structure, ~0.1 ADA cheaper.

privacyPolicy.intro: Artifi Labs is committed to privacy and transparency. This Privacy Policy outlines what data we collect and how it is used.

paragraphs.analytics1: We use PostHog to collect limited analytics and application telemetry. This helps us understand how the app is used and identify bugs or performance issues.
paragraphs.analytics2: Data collected by PostHog does not include personally identifiable information. We do not store wallet addresses, names, emails, or any user credentials.
paragraphs.analytics3: All analytics are used strictly for the purpose of improving the application experience.
paragraphs.authentication: The application does not use or require any user accounts, logins, or email registration. Access is anonymous.
paragraphs.contact: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:
paragraphs.noPersonalData: We do not collect or store any personal data. Any data accessed or displayed by the application comes exclusively from publicly data available on the blockchain.
paragraphs.openSource: This application is open source and licensed under the
paragraphs.policy: We may revise this policy over time. Updates will be posted here with a new effective date.
paragraphs.wallet: When users interact with the app using their Cardano wallet, we interact only with the wallet interface via the CIP-30 standard. We do not receive or store your private keys. We reserve the right to store your addresses and transactions for analytical purposes to allow us to learn from your usage of the app and to improve it based on this information.
